_comment: Configuration of the knowledge-system tools (gate_impact.py, gate_accuracy.py, states.py, knowledge_status.py). Policy lives here, never in the tools.

held_queue._comment: Who resolves a held intake item, by the reason the gate gave, and how many days it may wait.

resolvers.resolver: the owner (the gate's rule: contradictions go to the owner)
the contributor (declare extends, recognized-as or distinct-from)

review_cycles._comment: Days after capture or adoption when a source or an adopted decision must be re-confirmed.

states._comment: The lifecycle states (architecture text §4, SRC-0010, pending LXM-DEC-000015), in order. A state is reached only with its evidence. Designed is evidenced by a specification document: one named in trace.txt (spec:), or the specification of every implementing module's owning domain (domain_specs, read through the repository's domain registry). Configured and Enforced at runtime apply only to requirements that govern configuration; for others they are not applicable, which is not a gap. runtime_traced_declarations: the declarations a runtime read trace covers.
